_meta.purpose: Single source of financial assumptions for every acc-cfo decision model. Every value carries a confidence tag. Models MUST surface the tag of any assumption their answer depends on.

confidence_tags.KNOWN: Traced to live Jobber/CallRail data or an ingested bookkeeper statement. Has a source and a date.
confidence_tags.ESTIMATE: Industry benchmark or reasoned assumption. Directional only. Never present as fact.
confidence_tags.UNKNOWN: Not available. Blocks any model that depends on it. Do not substitute a plausible number.

_meta.scope: Got Moles operations. Entity-level (Rainier Power Wash LLC) figures are inputs, not scope.

t12_billed.note: 2.1% below t12_revenue over the same window. Different measurement basis (billed vs recognized). Reconcile at first monthly close.

seasonality._note: Index = month billed / mean monthly billed. Derived 2026-08-26 from 12 complete months of Jobber billing. SUPERSEDES the 'trough Nov-May' claim in got-moles-scale/brief.md, which the data does not support: Nov indexes 1.15 and Apr-Jun run 0.99-1.13. The real trough is Dec-Feb.
seasonality.caveat: Single year of history. Directional. Re-derive each year.

acquisition._note: The single most seasonally concentrated thing in the business. 64.6% of all new customers arrive in a 4-month window. January produced SIX. Marketing dollars are not fungible across months.

new_customer_share_of_revenue.note: 82% of revenue comes from EXISTING customers. Winter revenue is almost entirely the recurring base. This is the financial argument for TMCP.

collections._note: Dollar-weighted collection curve across $833,958 of collected history. Used by model-cash.mjs.

open_ar.note: STALE. Re-pull before any cash decision.

dso_implied_days.source: derived from curve; 95.7% collected within one month

close_rate.note: Elite. Sector norm 30-50%. Growth is lead-constrained, not conversion-constrained.

gross_expected_value_per_lead.note: GROSS. This is revenue, not value. True per-lead worth requires contribution margin, which is UNKNOWN.

leadsource_unknown_rate.note: BLOCKS CAC-by-channel entirely. Fixing intake attribution is a prerequisite, not a nice-to-have.

median_revenue_per_client_24mo.note: Mean is 2x median: top 10% of clients are 37% of revenue. Concentration risk worth watching.

tmcp_active.conflict: context/MEMORY.md 2026-08-11 reports 674 jobs / 653 clients and MRR $74.2K. $74.2K x 12 = $890K > entire t12 revenue of $857K. UNRESOLVED — see open_conflicts.

churn_rate.blocker: Only 20 TMCP-Churned tags exist against 597 active. Churn is not being tracked.
churn_rate.why_it_matters: Churn drives LTV, and retention is a named driver of the valuation multiple. Sector benchmark 82-87% residential retention.

revenue_per_visit.note: At this ticket size, profit is stops-per-mile. Route density IS the margin lever.

planning_visit_minutes.note: The planning assumption used in the baseline. Measured pace is higher — use measured.

measured_median_minutes_per_stop.source: tech-pace.mjs, 2142 completed visits with completedAt stamps, 2026-07-13..08-09
measured_median_minutes_per_stop.caveat: Gap between consecutive completion stamps — blends drive time with on-site time. Dense ground flatters, spread ground penalizes. A 23% spread across techs.

directed_service_times.note: Cory 12min check / 24 set; all others 15/30. These are DIRECTED planning numbers, not measurements.

quick_fix.note: 5-week weekly series. No-catch guarantee at all sizes.

no_catch_bill.note: Existing customers billed $150 if no catch, full rate if caught.

commercial_and_over_5_acre.note: Never quoted by phone. In-person bid, owned by Cory.

costs._note: THE BLOCKING GAP. Every value here is UNKNOWN. No margin, no unit economics, and no defensible hire/price/ad decision exists until these land. Source: bookkeeper statements into cfo-private/. Request list: 2026-08-26_bookkeeper-request.md

tech_base_hourly_wage.note: Per-person figures never enter this file. Read at run time by model-tech-contribution.mjs.

labor_burden_rate.source: Gusto payroll-trends export 2025-10..2026-09 (private/gusto): employer cost / gross earnings = 1.113-1.117 Jul-Sep 2026. Employer contributions (benefits) = 0.
labor_burden_rate.components: L&I workers comp (WA monopolistic state fund, rate by risk class), PFML, WA Cares, FUTA, SUTA, employer FICA, any benefits
labor_burden_rate.note: Covers employer FICA, FUTA/SUTA, L&I, no benefits. Supersedes the 0.25 placeholder.

vehicle_cost_per_tech_month.components: lease or depreciation, insurance, maintenance, registration

software_stack_monthly.components: Jobber, OptimoRoute, CallRail, Telnyx, Ninety, Google Workspace, AI/API spend

ads_spend_monthly.blocker: Google Ads API creds absent on this install; snapshot JSONs are stale baseline only.

headcount_w2.note: Field techs known by name: Alias, Cory, Robert, Luke, plus Spencer. Cammeron departed. Tavis started 2026-08-17.

company_loaded_cost_per_paid_hour.source: Gusto payroll trends Aug 2026: employer cost 32,832.61 / (898.4 reg + 90.5 OT h). Jul 31.6, Sep-to-date 35.8.
company_loaded_cost_per_paid_hour.caveat: Numerator includes salaried and office pay; denominator is hourly-clocked hours only. Overstates a field tech rate. Replace with per-tech rates in cfo-private/tech-rates.json.

monthly_payroll_employer_cost.note: Company-wide aggregate only, Gusto payroll-trends export 2025-10-01..2026-09-18. 2026-09 is partial (through the 18th).

derived_blocked._note: Cannot be computed until costs land. Listed so no model quietly invents them.

cac_by_channel.blocker: 85% leadSource unknown AND ads spend unavailable. Two independent blockers.

tech_contribution.note: Revenue serviced per tech is KNOWN (Jobber contracts x visit share). Labor cost per tech is ESTIMATE until tech-rates.json exists. Vehicle/fuel/materials still UNKNOWN, so contribution is labor-only.

entity._note: Rainier Power Wash LLC. Inputs only — not the scope of this skill. Get from the CPA.

tax_election.note: S-corp vs partnership vs disregarded changes owner comp strategy entirely.

owner_draw_floor.note: THE HARD CONSTRAINT in the decision policy. Ask Spencer directly — what do you need to take out per year, minimum.

labor_law_wa._note: Cost-relevant WA figures. Full detail and sources in .claude/skills/ops-hr/references/wa-compliance.md

exempt_salary_threshold_2026.flag: A salaried person paid below this is NON-EXEMPT and owed overtime regardless of title. Cory is salaried and runs a full route. CHECK THIS.

overtime.note: 1.5x after 40 hours per workweek. WA has no daily overtime.

workers_comp.note: WA is a monopolistic state fund (L&I). No private carrier. Rate set by risk classification; misclassification is assessed retroactively with penalties.

salaried_field_role_exempt_check.finding: The one salaried field tech is paid BELOW the 2026 WA exempt salary threshold (80,168.40), so the role is NON-EXEMPT: hours must be tracked and overtime paid over 40 h/wk regardless of title. He does not clock in today. Fix: either raise salary above the threshold or put him on the time clock. Dollar figure in cfo-private only.

industry_benchmarks._note: ALL ESTIMATE. Comparison targets only — never substitute for Got Moles actuals.

gross_margin_average.source: NPMA / PCO Bookkeepers 2025 Pest Control Industry Cost Study

revenue_growth_average.note: Got Moles at 0.37 is ~4x sector average.

recurring_share_of_revenue.note: Sector average. A target to measure against.

valuation._note: Recurring mix moves the MULTIPLE, not just the profit. This is the largest single lever on enterprise value and it is why TMCP conversion is a capital allocation decision, not a marketing campaign.
valuation.source: 2026 pest control M&A multiple guides (Breakwater M&A, CT Acquisitions, PestPac)
valuation.got_moles_read: Tech stack and growth rate are already strong. Recurring share, retention and management depth are the three that are either unmeasured or actively weak.

open_conflicts.title: Seasonality claim contradicts billing data
open_conflicts.b: Billing history: Nov indexes 1.145, Apr 1.064, Jun 1.130. Real trough is Dec-Feb at 0.812.
open_conflicts.status: RESOLVED in favor of the data 2026-08-26. Seasonality index above is authoritative.
